sqlMap.select:
SELECT T.S_WORK_AREA, SY0.CONTENT S_WORK_AREA_NAME, T.E_WORK_AREA, SY1.CONTENT E_WORK_AREA_NAME , T.COEFFICIENT FROM PA_CITYCOEFFICIENT T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE T.S_WORK_AREA = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.E_WORK_AREA = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$
ORDER BY T.S_WORK_AREA

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PA_CITYCOEFFICIENT T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE T.S_WORK_AREA = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.E_WORK_AREA = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PA_CITYCOEFFICIENT T WHERE T.S_WORK_AREA = #S_WORK_AREA:VARCHAR# AND T.E_WORK_AREA = #E_WORK_AREA:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO PA_CITYCOEFFICIENT ( S_WORK_AREA, E_WORK_AREA, COEFFICIENT, ORDER_NO, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, ACTIVITY ) VALUES ( #S_WORK_AREA:VARCHAR#, #E_WORK_AREA:VARCHAR#, #COEFFICIENT:NUMERIC#, (SELECT NVL(MAX(ORDER_NO),0)+1 FROM PA_CITYCOEFFICIENT), SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, 1 )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE PA_CITYCOEFFICIENT PC SET PC.S_WORK_AREA = #S_WORK_AREA:VARCHAR#, PC.E_WORK_AREA = #E_WORK_AREA:VARCHAR#, PC.COEFFICIENT = #CITY_COEFFICIENT:NUMERIC#, PC.UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, PC.UPDATED_BY = #UPDATED_BY:VARCHAR# WHERE PC.S_WORK_AREA = #SS_WORK_AREA:VARCHAR# AND PC.E_WORK_AREA = #EE_WORK_AREA:VARCHAR#
